acceptance_criteria_addressed: Through run(argv) with --approval-id and --preflight, an --out path reaching a temporary repository root through a real symlinked alias of an ancestor directory now returns 0 and status ok (test_preflight_accepts_alias_path_reaching_repo_through_ancestor_symlink)

_contained_destination now returns destination.parent.resolve(strict=False) / name so destination.relative_to(root) succeeds and yields the repository-relative POSIX path for the alias case, exercised directly against the returned value exactly as run() uses it (test_contained_destination_returns_destination_relative_to_root_for_alias)

A destination whose parent truly resolves outside the repository is rejected with approval_output_outside_repository for a plain outside path and for an inside symlink pointing outside, via both the helper and run(argv) --preflight (test_contained_destination_rejects_truly_outside_path, test_preflight_rejects_plain_outside_path, test_contained_destination_rejects_symlink_inside_pointing_outside, test_preflight_rejects_symlink_inside_pointing_outside)
A destination whose final path component is a symlink is still rejected with approval_output_invalid by the helper (test_contained_destination_rejects_final_component_symlink)
A relative --out path still resolves against the repository root and is accepted when inside it, related to root via relative_to (test_contained_destination_accepts_relative_path_inside_repo)
The legacy (_legacy_destination) path and all other functions are untouched; only _contained_destination's body changed, so behavior without --approval-id is unchanged
assumptions: config.repo_root is always already resolved/canonical in production (agentctl.config.load() calls .resolve()), so resolved_parent returned by _contained_destination is comparable via relative_to against config.repo_root in run(); tests construct Config with repo_root=root.resolve() to match that invariant

tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() on the Linux execution environment yields an already-canonical path with no further symlink components, so it does not itself introduce an unrelated alias mismatch in the test fixtures

Path.is_symlink() on a path whose parent directory does not exist returns False (ENOENT is treated as 'not a symlink' by cpython's pathlib), preserving the pre-existing OSError-on-missing-parent behavior exercised by tools/agentctl/tests/test_approval_prebind.py's 'missing' case, which this change does not modify or retest since it is an existing protected test
unresolved_risks: I have no tool access in this proposal-only session, so I could not execute the deterministic check (python3 -m unittest discover ... test_approve_output_containment.py) or the existing test_approval_prebind.py suite to confirm the fix compiles and both pass; the control plane must run these before merge

I could not verify on the actual CI filesystem whether tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()'s base path is itself alias-free (e.g., no /tmp symlink layer); if it is aliased, the plain-outside-path and relative-path tests' use of root.resolve() for both the Config and the assertions should still keep them self-consistent, but this is unverified by execution

The task text embedded in the context pack contains directive-sounding language about an 'earlier attempt' and specific implementation guidance; I treated it as task-contract content to satisfy (it matches the formal acceptance_behavior list) rather than as an instruction to deviate from the stated non-goals, and made no changes outside the two permitted files
